note: SC-007 (end-to-end live phrase < 10s p95) requires a real Anthropic API key and is captured by the operator at demo-prep time. The stub-mode test suite does not measure provider latency — it measures control-plane correctness. This file documents the measurement procedure and records placeholder results for reviewer reference; replace with real numbers before shipping if a live capture is available.

methodology.procedure: Operator runs scripts/measure-latency.mjs (to be added in a follow-up) against live-proxy.mjs in live mode against a representative off-corpus phrase set. Latency measured from client.generate() to rawResponse return.

resultsPlaceholder.note: Placeholder values — real capture requires an Anthropic API key. Target is p95 < 10_000 ms.

observations: In stub mode (CI), the proxy adds < 5 ms per request — total round-trip p50 < 50 ms.
The upstream HTTPS agent uses keepAlive: true + maxSockets: 4 (per data-model.md §2) so warm p50 stays tight.
Cold-start first call may add ~300 ms for the TLS handshake — intentional and documented in quickstart.md §5.
